Reach + follow alone cost 14.7 envsel points and J4 metal cannot add reach. The J4 hardware built across the full 26 mm width (2D-contoured band at q 1, race a surface of revolution, carriage, 4 wheel blocks, 95 mm strap) reads 74.53 frozen exact Bench(110,360) (79.79 envsel): carriage in band 0.34 (floats 10-22 mm: the race must clear the worst skin per azimuth), strap contacts on 54 poses, band vs torso 10. Row fields carry the hardware reading (every part sampled); the ideal is in ideal_frozen_exact.
limiter: reach on the ideal: 75 of 360 ws lost on Bench(110,360) exact frozen - fold 54 (no welded solution within PHI 45), hub-2 burials 12 (under the acromion at abduction 105-150, to 14.4 mm, the price of the psi2 -45 J2 re-placement), J3 stop 6, parts 3; then the J4 hardware: the arm-fixed race must clear the skin's per-azimuth maximum (skin swings 6-12 mm vs the humerus frame at s 0.30), so the carriage floats out of band (0.34), the strap meets the deltoid bunching (54 poses <= 2.6 mm) and the band meets the torso at across-body / extreme axial rotation (10 poses <= 12 mm)
note: Gate (ideal sweep, 6 envsel cells in order 19.70, 24.42, 23.14, 19.70, 36.15, 20.13): gain 0 score points over the second half, 0 over the last third, top-5 within 1.72 score points - passes formally on a thin local sweep (farm closed, <= 2 local processes). Axis convention checked against the judge's kin_static (312/360, 22/28 at a2 67 reproduce with raxis(8.75,-90) sgn +1). th margin min 5.001 on every taken pose. Near-touch: ideal 20.00 (1 mm) / 35.42 (2 mm); hardware 90.18 / 103.81. T5: ideal 19 contacts / 101.88 mm vs the lead's 4 / 20.24. Hardware is ONE unswept configuration (diagnostic). Not run: continuity flood (connected <= static), held-out (untouched), per-pose zero-return margin. Shoulder slip: standing price (p95 4.83 / max 5.14 mm at 3 mm GH offset; ~6.4/6.9 mm at R10 4 mm; 13-31 N vs 5 N); this build assumes a 2 mm liner under the band. A second hardware read with the strap fitted WITHOUT the 15 mm outlier cut (out_strap 80) is identical (74.53, strap contacts 54 <= 2.6 mm): the strap contacts are fit-set generalisation (q 1 on Bench(60,160) does not cover Bench(110,360)'s deltoid bunching), not the cut.
